headline: IMF: Pakistan’s economic policies are effective
summary: The IMF recognised progress in Pakistan's economic outlook, saying Extended Fund Facility measures have helped stabilise the economy, curb inflation and restore confidence. A new review round is due later this month.
why: The IMF's Extended Fund Facility lending programme conditions Pakistan's bailout financing on economic reforms, so IMF assessments shape investor views of the country's debt and currency risk.
